comment: Cross-platform habit memory corpus shared by Tests/MijiaCoreTests/GoldenCorpusTests.swift and windows/tests/core.test.ts (#113). Operations use the same flat {targetId, kind, value} encoding as intent_golden.json; `hour` is interpreted in the machine's local time zone by both ends.

memoryCases.name: first manual action creates a bucket entry and a receipt
repeat actions increment and the receipt remembers the previous count
records land in the matching time bucket
saturated memory evicts a stale decayed entry so a newly learned habit survives (#17)

topSuggestionCases.name: habits rank first and the engine pads to four
favorites, environment trim, and the builtin pad an empty memory
no controllable devices means no suggestions
already-satisfied habits are filtered and the builtin backfills
a color-temperature habit at the current kelvin is filtered and backfilled
the builtin backfills per-light power-offs up to the limit
recent habits outrank frequent but stale ones
weekend habits surface on weekends despite lower counts
a fresh transition boosts the likely next action
an all-off home with no memory still fills four executable actions
a returning vacuum is not offered a power toggle

sequenceCases.name: actions within the window learn a transition
undoing the second action removes the transition and restores the last action
actions outside the window learn nothing
repeating the same pair increments the transition count
partially undoing a multi-device step keeps the failed device as lastAction and preserves its transition
undoing an earlier step after a newer manual action preserves the newer lastAction
